Key Activities: As part of the Regional Census Center Management team, contributes to the development of regional strategies and operational plans, and manages the organization, planning, scheduling and control of Census data collection activities (7-day, collection operation) for a large regional area comprised of a number of Census Field Offices (CFOs).

Manages the financial, human and material resources for the assigned area; and monitors, analyzes and resolves problems associated with resource allocations/expenditures and human resource recruitment strategies for the CFOs.
Directs statistical data collection activities for the assigned CFOs, and contributes to the planning and implementation of collection methodologies and techniques related to the Census Program.

Monitors response patterns and respondent behaviour, variances in response rates, assesses their impact on field collection operations within the area and provides advice and guidance on options to resolve problems identified.

As a subject matter expert, provides expert direction and guidance to CFO Managers and staff on the interpretation of departmental legislation and the application of Statistics Canada policies and procedures; and leads the preparation and delivery of training to CFO Managers.
Represents the department at area public relations venues intended to promote Census participation.

Represents the Region or Regional Census Center area in regional and/or departmental committees or departmental multidisciplinary project teams as a Census collection expert and provides advice on proposed modifications to operational procedures.

Oversees the dissemination and collection of evaluation reports for the assigned Region or Regional Census Center; and contributes, through briefings to discussions on enhancements to the overall Census Program.

Decision making: Effort is required to make decisions/recommendations on strategies and operational plans for multiple Census Field Offices; the organization, planning and scheduling of Census data collection activities (7-day, collection operation) for a large regional area; the resolution of problems associated with resource allocations/expenditures and human resource recruitment strategies for the CFOs; the provision of advice and expert guidance on collection methodologies and techniques related to the Census Program; action required to resolve unacceptable response patterns and strategies to promote Census participation; the analysis of evaluation reports for the assigned Region or Regional Census Center and recommendations for enhancements to the overall Census Program; the management of financial expenditures resources and ongoing analysis of CFO operations to ensure that they are within allocated budgets; and the day-to-day management of financial, human and material resources of the CFOs.
Decisions/recommendations made affect the efficient and effective operations of the CFOs and their compliance to the Statistics Act and departmental policies and procedures.
